title: Emenegger gave a copy of the documentary to Spielberg
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Emenegger gave a copy of the documentary to Spielberg, about 1975-1977 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: "No, he didn't tell me what I didn't tell you. I gave a copy to Spielberg."

plain: Grant Cameron, a longtime UFO researcher, relays what filmmaker Bob Emenegger told him about the mid 1970s. Emenegger had made a documentary called UFOs: Past, Present and Future, and Cameron says Emenegger told him he gave a copy of it to the film director Steven Spielberg, around the time Spielberg made his UFO film Close Encounters of the Third Kind. Cameron tells it on podcast host Jesse Michels's show as a link between government-backed UFO material and the famous Hollywood film.
